question: Which Satavahana king restored the Satavahana realm to its earlier greatness around 125 CE?
solution: The correct answer is __**Gautamiputra**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The Satavahana king who restored the Satavahana realm to its earlier greatness around 125 CE was Gautamiputra Satakarni. • He is widely regarded for his military prowess and efforts to restore the strength and territorial integrity of the Satavahana Empire, which had weakened due to internal strife and external invasions. • Gautamiputra Satakarni is known for his successful campaigns against the **Kshatrapas** (Western Kshatrapas) and other invaders, which allowed the Satavahanas to regain control over large parts of western and central India.
